scope: Current supplied implementation inspected; exact historical runtime unbound.
erratum: Historical null is a regex-export defect, not evidence of no truncation. Original export preserved unchanged.
character_budget: Cumulative read/probe observations only; not full context or token budget.
probe: Lengths of task id, original starter, test script, task family; not images.
success: Recorded passing test event; final untested programs not uniformly graded.
steps: Counter includes rejected next-step attempt at steps budget exhaustion.
